name: Dividend yield calculator
summary: Turn price and annual dividend into yield and an optional payout ratio from EPS.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Yield = annualDividend / price. Payout = annualDividend / EPS when EPS is given. Does not fetch quotes or enroll in a DRIP.
